criteria.statement: refresh-commander-spellbook-data.mjs's VARIANTS_ENDPOINT is the bulk export URL; the paginated cursor walk and its resume-from-staged-pages machinery for variants are removed
the retry/backoff helpers are retained and still exercised by the Scryfall template-expansion calls
build-commander-spellbook-combos.mjs reads camelCase wire field names throughout, with no remaining snake_case reads
the build succeeds against a real-upstream-excerpt fixture and fails loudly against a snake_case fixture
commanderSpellbook fixtures are regenerated from real upstream bytes, not hand-authored
the detail artifact is concatenated, individually-gzip-compressed per-variant JSON records
the index artifact carries a variantId to offset/length byte-offset directory into the detail artifact
npm run data:refresh runs the combo download as one step of its existing chain; data:refresh-combos still refuses to run without --confirm-live-calls
a build-side test asserts the eval catalog's key shape matches the real build's output key shape
a failed or empty refresh/build never overwrites a valid committed snapshot
